title: Concatenation of Row Streams
statement: For any natural number $l$, any family of rows $\mathrm{row}(n,i)$ of Boolean words indexed by $n\in\mathbb N$ and $i<l$, and all natural numbers $n,m$, the stream of the first $n+m$ packed rows equals the stream of the first $n$ packed rows followed by the stream of the first $m$ packed rows of the shifted family $i\mapsto\mathrm{row}(n+i,i)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{row}$ assigns a Boolean word to each time and each coordinate $i<l$
replaced: For every row family and all counts $n$ and $m$, the stream of the first $n + m$ rows is the stream of the first $n$ rows followed by the stream of $m$ rows of the shifted family; the literal suffix is preserved.
